model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for the MistralV0.2-Base model fine-tuned on different medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms, with categories labeled “Cardio,” “Gastro,” “Infect,” “Neuro,” “Obstetrics,” and “Pediatrics,” appearing in that order from left to right. The vertical axis represents the negative log probability, labeled with a linear scale ranging from -22 to -27, with tick marks at intervals of 1. For each specialty, there are multiple bars representing individual data points; the bars are colored in shades of orange and a single bar is colored in light blue for the “Neuro” specialty. The bars vary in height, with the shortest bars around -22 and the tallest bars around -26. For example, the “Cardio” specialty has bars ranging from approximately -22.5 to -25.5, while the “Gastro” specialty has bars ranging from approximately -23 to -26. The “Neuro” specialty is represented by a single light blue bar at approximately -23.5. The bars are not explicitly sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
